review_text: I'd rate **Brews & Cinnamon 5 out of 5 stars**. My girlfriend and I visit this café several times every month because it's one of our favorite places to relax and enjoy great food together. Their new menu is fantastic, with delicious food and drinks, and the cozy atmosphere keeps us coming back every time. (favorite orders in the picture, must try)

I've tried their cinnamon roll twice, and it's good, though it's a little too sweet for someone with blood sugar concerns. The place is comfortable tonight, but I didn't eat anything because this is the third place I've visited today and I'm already really full. Anyway, they allowed me to stay for a while, which I appreciated.

The food is really good, chicken was well seasoned, quesedilla/taco moment was amazing and drinks were absolutely divine. One small problem was the rice. It was SO HARD. Ended up not finishing it cause it tasted like rice that you leave on the counter for a few hours.

As a foodie, I highly recommend their Shrimp Salvatore. Flavorful and amazing presentation. Prices are also affordable for meals. I wasn't able to try out their coffee and cinnamon rolls but we're definitely going back for those next time. Ambience was nice and the staff were polite and attentive. 10/10.

For me the BEST time to visit any coffee shop is in the morning— ALWAYS. And my first time here was not pleasant (even if it was a few minutes after their 12nn opening time)….. Came, parked early. Sign was not flipped to OPEN until I called to ask what time they open. Sauce of the tuscan chicken tasted moderately okay but tough meat and so was the rice. Table knife was not even provided. Spanish latte was tasty alright. Took out a box of assorted cinnamon rolls, aglio e olio shrimp, creamy chicken and tomato meat ball pastas, black pepper beef rice and quesadilla all were just passable. Poor wifi signal inside. Always got disconnected. HEADS UP: nearly there for 4 hours and when I left my clothes smelled bad. Management should check the OR's they issue also 'coz it has lapsed its validity date (09-06-23). Still welcome the idea of a second visit — hopefully, better service/staff attitude and improved food taste.

Cozy vibes and the comforting aroma of freshly baked cinnamon rolls—Cinnamon & Brews Lanang is such a treat! Their rolls are soft, fluffy, and perfectly sweet, pairing so well with their freshly brewed coffee. A great spot to relax, catch up with friends, or simply indulge your sweet tooth.
A nice place where to enjoy a good coffee, chilling. Internet is very slow, so , if you are a digital nomad or you need to work online can be a problem(I attach a photo of the speed test).

So nice ambiance at this shop, the place is just in front of GoHotel/ Phonex near Guadalupe Village. They have this signatured variety cinnamon rolls with toppings that are freshly baked... good thing is... it's not too sweet... just right for your coffee or smoothie. They also have some meals and fries that you can choose from. And yes they have WiFi. Owners and staff are very accommodating,would definitely go back.

The food and coffee here is great! In my opinio, even better than SB, not to mention cheaper and quieter. We ordered Honey Glazed Chicken, Beef Mushroom Pasta, Coffee Jelly, and Hazelnut frappe (good portions and prices are fair). But the thing that I like the most about the place is the ambiance. It's cozy, the seats are comfortable, and the place is very clean. If you're looking for a place to chill and catch up with friends, that's not filled with too many people, but can still enjoy good food and coffee, this is it.

The cafe is just across the street from Go Hotel Lanang. They make good cinnamon rolls in different flavors. We got one paired with a Hot Latte and an Iced Americano. Place is relaxing with the soothing music. They have a toilet and more seating on the second floor.
Coffee and cinnamon rolls are the best combo here. Prices are fair and the staff are friendly and approachable. The ambiance is great and very comfy to have fun with your loved ones❤️

The strawberry combo is so goood. The cinnamon rolls are soooo delicious. Great great great staff very friendly and approachable, they check with the customers if the aircon is at the right temp or needs to be adjusted. The cafe is giving an elegant vibe, however, they don't have readily available outlets for your devices (at that time) if you're planning to make it as your temporary work station
I really love their cinnamons. It's so good. will probably try some other foods the next time I get to visit.
Lavish coffee serving. Great tasting Cinnamon Rolls
